title: UPPSC Homeopathic Medical Officer HMO Admit Card 2026
intro: Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC Prayagraj) has officially released the Admit Card for the Homeopathic Medical Officer (HMO) Screening Examination 2026 (Advt. No. D-6/E-1/2025). The screening examination is scheduled to be conducted on 24 October 2026 across various designated exam centers in Uttar Pradesh. Candidates who have registered can download their UPPSC HMO Admit Card 2026 by entering their OTR number, Date of Birth, and Gender on the official commission portal at uppsc.up.nic.in.
importantDates: Answer Key Release : Within 5 days after exam
applicationFee: General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 105/- (Paid during application)
fullContentHtml:
UPPSC Homeopathic Medical Officer HMO Admit Card 2026 – Download Hall Ticket

Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC Prayagraj) has published the hall tickets for the Homeopathic Medical Officer (HMO) Screening Examination 2026 under Advertisement No. D-6/E-1/2025. Registered candidates appearing for the screening examination on 24 October 2026 can download their hall ticket directly through the official UPPSC candidate portal using their One Time Registration (OTR) credentials.

Important Dates

  • Admit Card Release Date : 23 October 2026
  • Screening Exam Date : 24 October 2026
  • Exam Shift Timing : Check Hall Ticket for designated shift & reporting time
  • Answer Key Date : Expected within one week post exam

How to Download UPPSC Homeopathic Medical Officer Admit Card 2026

  1. Visit the official website of Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission at uppsc.up.nic.in.
  2. Under the 'Candidate Help Desk / Important Alerts' section, click on 'Download Admit Card for Homeopathic Medical Officer Screening Examination 2026'.
  3. Enter your One Time Registration (OTR) Number.
  4. Fill in your Date of Birth, Gender, and the verification Captcha code.
  5. Click on 'Download Admit Card' to view and save your hall ticket.
  6. Print at least two clear copies of the admit card and verify your allotted examination centre.

Important Links

  • Download HMO Admit Card
  • Download Exam Notice PDF
  • Official Website

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

When is the UPPSC Homeopathic Medical Officer Screening Exam 2026?

The screening examination is scheduled to be conducted on 24 October 2026 across designated test centers in Uttar Pradesh.

What credentials are required to download UPPSC HMO Admit Card?

Candidates need their UPPSC OTR Number, Date of Birth, Gender, and Captcha code to access the admit card download portal.

Where is the official link to download the hall ticket?

Direct verified links to download the admit card are available in the Important Links table above and on uppsc.up.nic.in.
